title: schlumbergera microsphaerica subsp. candida
intro: Schlumbergera microsphaerica subsp. candida, commonly known as the Christmas Cactus 'Candidum', is a species of flowering plant in the family Cactaceae. This plant is a popular ornamental species known for its white, funnel-shaped flowers that bloom around the holiday season. The health benefits of Schlumbergera microsphaerica subsp. candida are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been shown to help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. However, the therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, and more research is needed to fully understand its potential uses.
